summary: Implemented the sole authorized Pro Proposal 7 audit as an exact rational equal-radius Walsh Gram. The rank-72 objective has exact control squared minimum 144. Exhaustive zero-residual moment DP and complete residual-one low-base enumeration prove that the obstruction has no unrestricted vector through squared radius 192; a parity witness gives upper bound 216. Thus this fixed obstruction has certified squared-distance ratio at least 193/144>4/3. This is finite evidence only and establishes no composition or asymptotic hardness lemma.
hypothesis: Discrepancy rows may assign different vectors but equal norm to honest encodings, thereby charging affine signed selectors without requiring a common syndrome; the bounded target was obstruction squared distance strictly above four thirds of the exact control radius.

tests.finding: Verified the exact factor, target, rational center, control minimum 144, empty unrestricted obstruction shell through 192, lower/upper obstruction bounds 193 and 216, and finite squared-ratio lower bound 193/144>4/3.
The verifier compiles and the emitted 298-row factor/target manifest is valid JSON.
The Generation-11 degree-three source checks still verify after reuse by the new Gram audit.

next_experiment: Apply the same frozen Walsh/residual rule to one deterministic two-block overlap composition with a matched satisfiable control, derive its unrestricted shell bound before search, and test whether the obstruction/control squared ratio remains strictly above 193/144; kill on a drop, affine parity, control mismatch, or ratio non-growth.
